summary: Current implementation satisfies the saved P1 control-plane restart recovery hardening plan. Worker recovery for persisted monitoring_pr rows runs before ready execution, claims monitor ownership, clears stale execution claims while preserving the active monitor claim, preserves and reports unexpired execution claims, creates remonitor operations and workspace.monitor_recovery_started events with structured claim_cleanup details, avoids full feature execution, and remains idempotent when another worker already holds an active monitor lease. Focused worker and repository regressions are present, and validation passed: tests/unit/control/test_worker.py, tests/unit/db/test_repository_coverage.py, ruff, mypy, and the full unit suite.
